accountRetention: For as long as you have one. The club does not delete an account for being unused, so one you stop using is kept until you delete it. You can do that yourself, at any time — section 7 says how. If the club ever starts clearing out accounts nobody uses, this notice will say so before it does.
accountDeletionAndEntries: deleting your account does not delete that entry. A race entry is the record of a payment, it is kept as part of the club's financial records, and you will still be on the start list. Asking us to erase the entry itself is a separate request and a different answer — the race's own privacy notice says what happens then. Any medical note you gave with an entry is deleted on its own schedule whichever you do, and deleting your account does not change when.
